Subject: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards questions

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the demo last week — Carlos and I went through the recording and had a couple of follow-ups specifically around the observability add-ons: retention tiers, tracing storage, and the advanced dashboards pack. Two quick asks:

1) If we commit to a 12-month reserved plan for Dedicated capacity, what kind of discount can you offer on the observability suite (retention + tracing + dashboards)?
2) We have a mix of high-cardinality traces from checkout services — how do you price the tracing retention (GB-month vs events)? Any surcharge per seat or per user for dashboard viewers?

Also curious if Redwood offers short-term trial credits for the add-on so we can validate retention buckets without a long lock-in.

Can you send a concrete proposal with numbers and any standard SOW language we should expect?

Appreciate it —
Aisha Kapoor
Director, Platform Engineering
Helio Retail

Hi Aisha / Carlos —

Thanks for the clear list. Summary answer up front, and I attached a short pricing workbook and a draft SOW: pricing_v3.xlsx, sow-helio-observability.pdf.

- 12-month commit: we can offer 15% off list on observability add-ons (retention + tracing + advanced dashboards) with a 12-month monetary commitment tied to the Dedicated contract (applies only to add-on line items).
- Early validation credits: we can provide a one-time trial credit equal to $12k in observability credits (valid 90 days) to exercise retention buckets and dashboards against a staging workload.
- Tracing pricing: base pricing is $0.18 per GB-month for trace storage (post-ingest compressed), and we charge $0.02 per 100k sampled spans for indexing/trace-search. For high-cardinality workloads we recommend sampling + tag-based rollups — that keeps index costs predictable.
- Dashboard viewers: no per-seat surcharge for up to 50 viewers; above 50 viewers, a small seat surcharge of $5/user/month applies for enterprise features (SSO, audit log export).

If Helio wants a steeper discount we can structure a tiered multiplier tied to committed observability spend: 15% at $50k/yr, 20% at $120k/yr, subject to approval.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll put the pricing workbook in the Drive link (attached) and draft SOW for legal review.
- If that looks reasonable, let’s schedule a 30-minute call to walk the numbers and agree on which retention buckets you want active in staging (30d/90d/365d).

Attached: pricing_v3.xlsx (observability workbook), sow-helio-observability.pdf (draft SOW)

Regards,

Michael Grant
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards questions

Michael / Aisha — quick internal note to surface a couple of implementation constraints so the pricing matches the technical plan:

- Tracing storage: our catalog price is per GB-month compressed storage. For Helio’s checkout traces (high-cardinality), recommend default sampling ~1% with tag-preserve on checkout_id for 30d, then rollup to 90d at aggregated metrics; full 365d kept at event-summary level only. This approach typically keeps storage growth within the $0.18/GB-month profile I mentioned.

- Retention buckets: we support arbitrary buckets but billing aligns to the highest retention tier used per stream. If Helio wants multiple streams at different retention periods, the workbook has a helper sheet to model mixed buckets.

- Viewer seats and dashboards: advanced dashboards bundle includes 10 editable authors and unlimited read-only viewers for product analytics; the $5/user/month surcharge only kicks in when you require SSO-backed enterprise viewers >50.

I'll add a short FAQ page to the Drive link as well. If Helio is looking to avoid any per-seat complexity we can propose a flat bundle for dashboards at $6k/month in lieu of seat billing for larger orgs.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
